name: Peek into the neighbouring scene at a lower LOD
body: Rendering: a neighbour that streaming has not loaded is shown only through the opening that joins it: a proxy of the neighbour's near geometry (merged boxes, no collision, no lights, no entities) drawn when the opening is on screen and clipped to the socket's rectangle. Proxy built by the baked scene, never from Calamus. Open questions: how simple the proxy is (the scene's blocks within some depth of the socket, simplified to their bounding boxes) and whether the clip is a stencil, a scissor on the projected rectangle, or just a depth limit.
